title: Normalized global tuning entry definition (legacy globals domain, loaded)
description: Contract for one normalized tuning constant: one loaded legacy globals entry (stored plus the single powerup add). The constant name is the stable identity, so legacy_id is the name verbatim (rule G3); the value is kept verbatim as observed JSON with its type recorded (rule G2), and string constants stay opaque, never parsed. See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey/census citations.

legacy_id.description: Loaded globals constant name preserved verbatim (rule G3).

kind.description: Classification of the loaded globals domain: every entry maps to global_entry.

source_file.description: Origin file of the loaded entry: config/main.json for stored constants, config/patch/atom_fusion_powerup.json for the single added schedule.

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored, or patched(atom_fusion_powerup) for the single added schedule (rule G1).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes, the powerup patch bytes, and the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

key.description: Loaded globals constant name, kept verbatim; equals legacy_id (rule G3).

value_type.description: Recorded JSON type of the verbatim value: integer, number, string, array, object, boolean, or null (rule G2).

value.description: Tuning value kept verbatim as observed JSON; string constants stay opaque and are never parsed as references or behavior (rule G2).
